_budgets: [ASSUMED, Daniel rules] The three budgets below are the maintenance calendar's thresholds (row M2), not a ruling. LCP 2500 ms and CLS 0.1 are the Core Web Vitals 'good' bounds. TBT 200 ms stands in for INP, which a lab run cannot measure: web.dev calls TBT 'a reasonable proxy metric for INP for the lab but not a substitute for INP'. Each is judged on the median of 3 runs. tools/maint_quality.py perf reads only the ci key and fills collect.url from the served HTML at run time.
